# A New Beginning

My interests in becoming the creator of the setting, music wise, has only been increasing after sharing my progress during the jury. I had a lot of people listening and watching me, and I did the same to them. watching how they enjoyed what I created felt so rewarding and I want to continue giving people that feeling. 

So my journey continues...

## Evolving the FE_VER_ID

During my jury I found a lot of people enjoying the tune I build then and there. It's something that was never heard before so why not making it something that is 110% me, FE_VER.

 ## Creation of FE_VER_DREAM

 The need of creating something that would put me in a trance while raving was becoming stronger and stronger. What I like about trance techno is the way that the music can put you in a state of feeling euphoric and like your dreaming, all while being sober. A healthy alternative I would say ;) 
 
 Press play, close your eyes, and let the melody do the rest.
